name: claude-skills
description: Claude Code skills by Seevali Rathnayake: design-council (a five-designer critique panel), mission-command (a scarce flagship model conducting a fleet of cheaper models) and ratification-docket (decision ballots from dense documents).

plugins.name: design-council
plugins.description: Channels five master designers — Jony Ive, Dieter Rams, Zaha Hadid, Bjarke Ingels, and Don Norman — as a consultative panel for any design work.

plugins.name: mission-command
plugins.description: Runs a scarce flagship model as the conductor of a cheap-model fleet: vision-first autonomy, per-agent model/effort pinning, disk-portable protocols, and gated autonomy.

plugins.name: ratification-docket
plugins.description: Turns Proposed decisions spread across dense documents into a plain-language ballot page the owner rules on without reading them, then applies the answers to the records, trackers and ledgers.
